Method of Attack: Multi-stage attack involving downloading and executing malicious executables
Stage one: Connects to a suspicious URL to download 'stub.exe' using setup.py
Stage three: Executes 'main.exe' which records sensitive user data and credentials
Impacted Systems: Systems where Python packages are installed from unverified sources
Attack Vector: Supply chain attack via malicious Python package
Execution of malicious executables downloaded from a remote URL
